Method of Attack: Deletes all files in Windows data folders and creates password-protected 7zip archives of data folders using a hardcoded password
Uses legitimate 7zip command-line program (7za.exe) extracted as mod_01.exe to archive files
Archives files in user and public document folders into password-protected archives and deletes original files
Acts as a wiper on other drives by deleting data without archiving
Launches Internet Explorer to display a ransom note (help.html) in French
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user and public document folders
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted file naming format: username_foldername.vxcrypt (e.g., User_documents.vcrypt)
